thread:
anjali (platform): quick ping 10000idea: introduce 'scrubbed-replay' / 'compact-inspect' mode. purpose: have a tiny replayable artefact for canaries without storing plaintext. thoughts?

ryan (eng-ml): short TL;DR: we need enough signal to reproduce tokenization and model state but avoid raw spans. maybe token-id diffs + minimal context signatures.

anjali (platform): exactly. plan: capture metadata + token-id delta vector (compressed) + redaction-summary (type,count) + topk candidates for changed indices (encrypted). max size 1KB per snapshot.

mira (privacy): policy: automatic PII redaction on capture. if email/ssn/phone regex triggers, replace with <REDACTED:TYPE>. hashed-only approach okay for normal ops; reversible unmask needs HSM unwrap + legal ticket + RBAC group "privacy-reviewers".

dan (support): for triage, masked previews (first char + ****) usually help. support workflow: async unmask request button that records ticket id and reason.

owen (prod): per-tenant quota needed. tenants could run noisy canaries and exhaust storage. add inspect_quota_bytes and inspect_quota_used and an auto-throttle when near limit. also emit quota_alert events.

infra-bot: feature branch scrubbed-replay -> canary cluster deploy scheduled

ryan (eng-ml): implementation note: use token-id frequency vectors + changed indices + top-2 token ids per index. store encrypted with envelope keys; redaction run pre-store.

mira (privacy): unmask workflow rules:
- operator must be in RBAC "privacy-reviewers"
- require 2FA and a legal ticket id
- unmask action creates immutable audit log: operator, time, ticket
- unmasked artefact TTL default 7d then auto-delete + KMS audit event

anjali (platform): API sketch (server enforces):
POST /v1/responses
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <$TOKEN>
  x-rw-inspect-mode: compact|full|off
  x-rw-inspect-reason: canary|debug
Body: {"prompt":"..."}

ryan (eng-ml): tokens should include claim snapshot_allowed, server rejects header if token lacks claim.

dan (support): console UX requests: show snapshot_sample_rate, snapshot_quota_used, last_snapshot_time, redaction_rule_hash, unmask_requests (status). allow async unmask with reason + ticket.

owen (prod): telemetry: snapshot_created_total, avg_snapshot_bytes, snapshot_redaction_hits_total, snapshot_unmask_request_total, avg_unmask_latency_ms, snapshot_quota_exhausted_total. alert when snapshot_quota_exhausted_total > 0 for 5m.

mira (privacy): final: zero tolerance for plaintext emails/SSNs in snapshot storage. periodic audit job to sample stored snapshots and verify redaction.

anjali (platform): action items:
- (ryan) prototype compact snapshot encoder and bench (2w)
- (mira) draft unmask/HSM spec + legal checklist (this week)
- (owen) quota + alert + console mockups (EoW)
- (dan) catalog support cases needing unmask (EoW)

infra-bot: meeting created: "compact-inspect design sync" tomorrow 09:30 PT

anjali (platform): thanks everyone :thumbsup:
